# CANDIDATE: ATR_CONTRACTION_ORB_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When ATR contracts signaling low volatility, a breakout of the opening range with above-average volume tends to continue, offering an edge. The contraction indicates a coiled market poised for a move, and volume-confirmed OR breakouts capture institutional participation that often drives follow-through.

## Mechanism

Entry: When ATR(5) < 0.5 * ATR(20) for three consecutive 5‑minute bars AND price breaks above the opening range high (ORH) with volume > 1.5 * average volume of the first 30‑minute bars, go long at the close of the breakout bar; if price breaks below the opening range low (ORL) with the same volume condition, go short at the close of the breakout bar. Exit: Initial chart‑stop placed at the opposite side of the opening range (ORL for longs, ORH for shorts); take profit 1 at 2× ATR(5) from entry; if 1R is reached, trail the remainder with a chandelier exit (3× ATR(22)). Regime filter: only trade when VIX < 15 and ribbon slope |slope| < 0.1% (choppy/non‑trending); skip when VIX > 25 or ribbon slope > 0.1%.
